# dok

> A Rust CLI that makes Docker's output readable: `docker ps`, `images`,
> `inspect`, `logs`, `df` and more, rendered for humans with colour that means
> something, compose-project grouping, and human sizes and ages. What eza is to
> `ls`. One static, pipeable screen per command. Read-only — it never starts,
> stops, execs into or removes a container.

Install: `brew install alsaadii98/tap/dok` · `cargo install dok-cli` (crate is
`dok-cli`, binary is `dok`). Requires a reachable Docker daemon; honours
`DOCKER_HOST`. Every command takes `--demo` to run offline against a built-in
example stack. Current version: 0.3.0. MIT.

## Commands

- `dok ps` (`ls`): containers grouped by compose project — id, state dot, health mark, `:8080→80` ports, relative age.
- `dok ports`: every published port in one flat table sorted by host port. Answers "which container is using port 5432?". Skips exposed-but-unpublished ports, collapses the IPv4/IPv6 pair Docker reports for a wildcard binding, marks conflicting claims.
- `dok images` (`img`): images with size and age gradients, dangling marked reclaimable.
- `dok df` (`du`): disk usage per category with used/reclaimable bars, plus the biggest offenders with `-v`.
- `dok inspect`: the 400-line inspect JSON folded into readable sections, credential-looking env values masked by default.
- `dok logs`: interleaved multi-container tail with level colouring and JSON pretty-printing.
- `dok top`: processes inside containers, nested by parent PID.
- `dok tree`: compose projects, networks with IPs, volumes with mount points.
- `dok stats`: live CPU / memory / IO dashboard (the only full-screen command).
- `dok events`: daemon event stream, colour-coded by type and action.
- `dok themes`: list and preview the 10 built-in themes.
- `dok update` / `dok uninstall`: self-manage, or print the right package-manager command.

## Docs

- [Manual](https://dok.alsaadii98.com/man/): dok(1). Every command, option, output and JSON shape, generated from the binary.
- [How it works](https://dok.alsaadii98.com/man/internals/): dok(7). The socket, bollard, the read-only guarantee, ANSI-aware tables.
- [dok ports](https://dok.alsaadii98.com/man/ports/): find which container is using a port.
- [dok prune](https://dok.alsaadii98.com/man/prune/): see what docker system prune would delete.
- [dok history](https://dok.alsaadii98.com/man/history/): find which layer makes an image large.
- [dok health](https://dok.alsaadii98.com/man/health/): see why a healthcheck is failing.

- [Homepage](https://dok.alsaadii98.com/): overview, screenshots, install matrix, FAQ.
- [README](https://github.com/alsaadii98/dok/blob/main/README.md): full command reference and configuration.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/alsaadii98/dok/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): what is planned and what is up for grabs.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/alsaadii98/dok/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/alsaadii98/dok/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): code layout and how to add a command or theme.
